Class SiteRegisterController

public class SiteRegisterController

Salesforce-provided controller for portal user self-registration via Visualforce Sites. Creates a portal User and associated Contact under a designated portal account, then logs the user in or redirects to a confirmation page. This is a default class generated by Salesforce during org creation.

private Boolean isValidPassword()

Validates that password and confirmPassword fields match.

Returns:
    Boolean: true if passwords match, false otherwise

public PageReference registerUser()

Registers a new portal user. Validates passwords, creates the User via Site.createPortalUser(), then either logs the user in or redirects to the SiteRegisterConfirm page.

Returns:
    PageReference: Login page on success with password, confirmation page on success without password, or null on failure
